description: Use this when the person asks to put a Pugi website or app live ("publish", "go live"). Free. Puts the latest version on its pugi.app address after the security check every Pugi publish runs; publishing again replaces the live version.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse it to retry the same publish.

job_id.description: The job_id of the build (or the latest edit) to publish.

language.description: The language the person is writing in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

project_id.description: Or the project_id of that site.

publish_with_samples.description: Only after the person saw the list of sample details this tool answered with (sample_facts_remain) and chose to keep them.

name: publish
title: Publish a built site
